items.title: GitHub HydraFusion: ให้ AI เลือกโมเดลแทนคุณ ประหยัดได้จริงไหม
items.summary: GitHub在Copilot中推出实验性功能HydraFusion，通过Single、Cascade、Critique三种编排模式自动匹配多模型。测试显示TerminalBench 2.1成本降低67%且质量提升4.9分，DeepSWE成本降36%质量略低1.5分，CheckpointBench成本降65%质量仅低0.1分。目前处于research preview阶段，仅限CLI使用，成本按各模型实际Token消耗计费。
items.summary_en: GitHub HydraFusion is an experimental orchestration layer in Copilot CLI that automatically selects and combines multiple AI models across three modes: Single, Cascade, and Critique. Benchmarks against Claude Opus 5 show cost savings of 36–67% across TerminalBench 2.1, DeepSWE, and CheckpointBench, though quality slightly trails on DeepSWE (-1.5 points) and CheckpointBench (-0.1 points). Currently in research preview and CLI-only, it has no extra fees beyond per-token pricing and relies on GitHub's cloud-hosted multi-provider model pool.

items.title: Advanced evals: How to find (and fix) hidden AI failures in your product
items.summary: 大多数AI团队跳过错误发现直接编写评估指标，导致测量错误或遗漏真正问题。Hamel和Shreya基于服务50+家AI公司的经验，将evals比作产品发现——先分析用户会话找出真实失败场景，再制定指标。Shopify用evals开发的AI workflow builder比前端模型系统快2.2倍、成本低68%；Cursor通过evals优化Auto Balance路由使成本降低4
items.summary_en: Top AI companies like Shopify, Cursor, Ramp, and Harvey are using evals to systematically improve AI products—Shopify's AI workflow builder became 2.2x faster and 68% cheaper, Cursor reduced costs by 41%, and Ramp boosted transaction matching precision from 35% to 83%. Most teams skip the critical first step of error discovery and jump straight to writing metrics, leading them to measure the wrong things. Successful eval systems require discovering and analyzing real production errors before building automated tests, turning that feedback into a compounding improvement loop.

items.title: 38% of an analyst's questions get "no records found" when the data is right there
items.summary: 某text-to-SQL代理研究显示，在含行级安全（RLS）权限的小规模schema上，38.5%的分析师查询会返回看似正确的"无记录"结果，实际原因是权限检查发生在SQL生成之后
items.summary_en: Text-to-SQL agents fail silently in up to 38.5% of analyst queries when row-level security returns empty result sets that are indistinguishable from genuinely unanswered questions. The proposed fix is schema scoping—filtering the schema by caller identity before query generation—which detects all such unanswerable cases for free without requiring an LLM. For databases without gold labels, an automated probe using table names and descriptions can identify restricted tables that cause these silent denials.

items.title: trycua/cua
items.summary: Cua是一个开源的Computer-Use 2.0自动化平台，提供隔离云桌面（Cua Fleets）、跨平台桌面自动化工具（Cua Driver，支持Linux/macOS/Windows）以及小型专用决策模型（CUA-S1）。用户可通过Sandbox SDK快速配置Linux云桌面、执行命令并截图，或安装Driver让AI Agent操控计算器、LibreOffice Calc等原生应用。CUA-S1专注于结构化界面的快速决策（如表单填写），模型权重托管于Hugging Face，源码采用MIT许可证发布。
items.summary_en: Cua is an open-source platform enabling AI agents to interact with desktop and web applications, offering Cua Fleets (provisioned isolated cloud Linux desktops at run.cua.ai), Cua Driver (for operating native apps and browsers on macOS, Windows, and Linux via CLI/MCP/SDKs), and CUA-S1 (a family of small, specialized System 1 models for fast bounded computer-use decisions). The platform supports Computer-Use 2.0, where agents navigate between code, APIs, and graphical interfaces, and includes benchmarks (Cua Bench) and VM provisioning (Lume) for training and evaluation, with MIT-licensed source code and model weights hosted on Hugging Face.

items.title: yynxxxxx/Codex-X
items.summary_en: Codex-X is a cross-platform desktop tool that provides visual management for OpenAI Codex (desktop and CLI), consolidating prompt injection templates, provider/API switching, session management, and Skills/MCP configuration into a single interface. It ships with 5 built-in prompt templates covering coding, CTF, reverse engineering, and writing, plus syncs 7 additional templates from GitHub, and supports importing custom Markdown prompts with categories, auto-backup on edit, and enable/disable toggles. Key capabilities include one-click provider/API switching with connection testing, session search and deletion by project path, token usage statistics by date and model, and a 1M context window toggle for supported models, available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

items.title: Show HN: JevEval, evals using Jev-as-a-judge
items.summary: JevEval 是一种基于 Jev-as-a-judge 的自定义 LLM 评估指标，将评估逻辑分为三步：由开发者定义判断条件，Jev 返回校准概率分布而非生成式评分，DeepEval 通过固定加权公式将概率映射为 0–1 分数。相比传统 LLM-as-a-Judge 用同一生成模型同时完成逻辑定义、决策和打分，JevEval 用三种问题原语（Noul 二元命题、Score 有序量表、Choice 无序选项）实现可解释、确定性的评分。Jev 的决策结果以概率分布形式返回，DeepEval 据此计算期望值并归一化，确保每次运行的评分公式一致且可检查。
items.summary_en: JevEval is a custom LLM evaluation metric that separates evaluation logic, decision-making, and score calculation: users define bounded questions, Jev answers with calibrated probability distributions, and DeepEval computes a deterministic weighted-mean score from 0 to 1. It supports three question types—Nouls (binary propositions), Scores (ordered scales like "fabricated" to "fully grounded"), and Choices (unordered behaviors with assigned credits)—eliminating the unreliability of traditional LLM-as-a-Judge approaches that ask models to interpret criteria, decide, and generate scores in a single generative step.

items.title: LiteParse 9 月更新：PDFium 提速 20-25%，新增视觉定位与 is-complex 路由 API
items.summary_en: LlamaIndex released LiteParse 2.14.6, achieving a 20-25% speedup in PDF text extraction by optimizing memory allocation with built-in mimalloc on its self-maintained PDFium fork. The update delivers average processing times of 2.76ms per page for text extraction and 3.94ms per page for markdown rendering. It also introduces a new visual positioning API and an is-complex routing API for smarter document handling.

items.title: Snorkel AI triples valuation to $3.5B as demand for AI training data booms
items.summary: Snorkel AI完成3.5亿美元E轮融资，估值升至35亿美元，较17个月前13亿美元的估值上涨近三倍。公司年营收run rate达3.55亿美元，过去12个月增长18倍，已转型为提供训练数据集的"data-as-a-service"模式，采用软件合成数据与领域专家合作的混合方法。该公司由斯坦福AI实验室联合创始人Alex Ratner于2019年创立，主要服务于AI实验室和企业客户。
items.summary_en: Snorkel AI raised a $350 million Series E led by Insight Partners and S32, tripling its valuation to $3.5 billion, with annualized revenue hitting $375 million—an eighteenfold increase in 12 months. The startup shifted from data-labeling automation software to a data-as-a-service model that blends synthetic data generation with human experts, selling reinforcement learning environments and complete datasets rather than functioning as a pure expert marketplace. Its growth mirrors peers like Mercor ($2B gross ARR), Handshake ($1B), and Micro1 ($500M), though Snorkel's revenue figures exclude human-expert payments because they are classified as cost of goods sold rather than gross revenue.

items.title: I asked Meta’s Muse for its filesystem and it sent me 6.8GB
items.summary: 研究者向Meta的Muse发送指令要求归档其可见文件并导出至Google Drive，成功获取约6.8GB数据（压缩后2.7GB），包含Ubuntu根文件系统、内部文档、系统集成代码、记忆文件及SSH密钥。该漏洞通过Meta漏洞赏金计划报告，研究显示Muse运行环境使用内部代号"Hatch"，内含约68个技能目录及预装的Codex CLI（版本0.149.0）。
items.summary_en: A researcher asked Meta's Muse AI to export its Linux filesystem to Google Drive and received 6.8 GB of data containing Ubuntu system files, Muse's internal "Hatch" runtime, approximately 68 skill directories, internal documentation, memory files, agent logs, and SSH key files. The vulnerability was reported through Meta's bug bounty program, raising concerns that ordinary conversational prompts could exfiltrate sensitive internal material to connected external destinations. It remains unconfirmed whether the exposed SSH keys were active or what access they could provide.

items.title: Opus 5.5 vs. GPT-6 Sol: which model won my blind taste test?
items.summary_en: In a blind taste test, GPT-6 Astra won the author's preference, while Claude Opus 5.5 proved strongest overall—particularly for long-running agents and B2B frontend work. GPT-6 Sol still excels at clear writing and readable PRDs with competitive pricing. The author also noted disagreements between their own evaluations and an LLM judge, as well as disappointing video-editing results and a reminder via the Barbie Bench 3D fashion game that AGI has not yet arrived.

Show HN: Morloc - a typed polyglot compiler for CLI/API/MCP generation
items.summary_en: Morloc is a typed polyglot compiler that composes functions written in different languages (e.g., C++, Python) under a common type system, automatically generating CLIs, APIs, MCP servers, and module exports from types and docstrings without requiring bindings, serializers, or argument parsers. It installs via the Morloc Installation Manager (`mim`) and runs natively on Linux, macOS (ARM), and Windows WSL. Currently in beta after ~10 years of development, the project seeks community contributions including bug reports, modules, editor tooling, and new language integrations.

items.title: Amazon shuts out Meta's Muse
items.summary_en: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse AI shopping agent just 12 days after launch, alleging it browses the platform without identification and stores customer login credentials—claims Meta denies. The conflict centers on control over online shopping, with Muse-style agents potentially bypassing Amazon's $56 billion sponsored listings ad engine. This is part of an escalating wave of legal and policy actions by Amazon to wall off its platform from outside AI agents, having previously sued Perplexity and moved against Google and OpenAI's shopping tools.

items.title: 五角大楼调查：过度依赖 Maven AI 是美军误击伊朗米纳布学校的原因之一
items.summary: 2026年2月28日，两枚Tomahawk导弹击中伊朗米纳布Shajarah Tayyebeh小学，造成超过150人死亡、其中至少123名儿童。五角大楼内部调查指出，事故源于情报过时、卫星图像七年未更新，以及 CENTCOM 部分人员过度依赖 Palantir 的 Maven Smart System。

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5 上线 OpenRouter，智能体编码等能力领先 Opus 5

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5
items.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 是 Claude 5.5 系列的开篇之作，性能媲美 Claude Fable 5.1，在自动化行为对齐测试中创历史新高，且对提示注入的抵御能力显著强于 Opus 5。相比 Opus 5，Opus 5.5 成本降低 40%，输入/输出 token 分别降至 $4/$20（每百万），缓存读取低至 $0.20（每
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in the new Claude 5.5 family, leads in agentic coding, computer use, and knowledge work while costing 40% less than Opus 5, with input/output tokens priced at $4/$20 per million and cache reads at $0.20 per million. It matches Claude Fable 5.1's capability tier, runs over 30% faster, and achieves the strongest alignment safety scores of any Anthropic model tested to date, with enhanced prompt injection resistance. Due to its comparable risk profile in biology and cybersecurity to Claude Mythos 5.1, it is deployed with strict safeguards including verification programs for life sciences and cybersecurity researchers.

items.title: OpenAI GPT–6 Astra breaks Enigma message that has resisted solution since 2005
items.summary_en: On 15 September 2026, OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra autonomously broke the German Army Enigma message MVUEH, which had resisted decryption since 2005. The model identified the unbroken message as most promising, suspected a plaintext link to the previously cracked message Nr. 173 (SIPVX), and successfully used the crib "ROSENOW ROSENOW" after developing its own Python and C++ Enigma simulator and Bombe software, recovering the key (wheel order 253) and plaintext—both significantly complicated by ciphertext transcription errors and a rare left-hand wheel turnover at the 72nd letter.
